name: Kiro Commands
description: Adds native /k* slash commands (kcompact, kclear, kusage, kcontext, kstats) that forward kiro-cli native commands to the channel's ACP child via kiro-proxy — with Discord autocomplete.

proxyUrl.description: Base URL of the kiro-proxy HTTP API. Defaults to http://localhost:18801 (matches systemd kiro-proxy.service).
